info.title: PlayerSense API
info.description: Organizations, projects and keys; the SDK's ingestion and configuration endpoints; cohort reporting; and one player's erasure or export.

post.summary: Accept a batch of analytics events
post.description: Answers 202 once the batch has reached durable queueing. The response says how many events were accepted and how many were dropped, so an SDK can stop retrying a batch that will never be accepted. The body may be sent with Content-Encoding: gzip or zstd; the size limit below applies to the decoded batch either way.

post.summary: Add credit to an organization's wallet
post.description: A `promo` expires — ninety days unless `expires_at` names another date — and is spent before purchased credit. A `purchase` does not expire and cannot be given a date. `granted_at` backdates the grant, which decides where purchased credit sits in the spend queue. `reference` is the idempotency key: the same one twice grants once.

post.summary: Erase everything held about one player
post.description: Records the request, stops the actor's events being accepted or served, and removes them asynchronously from the events, the two device-keyed summaries, the verified purchases and the archive. Returns immediately: removal is a rewrite of whole parts and whole objects and is measured in hours, which is why a tombstone goes up first.
